stories.title: North Wales Police launch road safety campaign to reduce motorcycle-related deaths
stories.summary: A dedicated road safety campaign, aimed at improving motorcyclist safety and reducing motorcycle-related deaths and injuries on the roads of North Wales is underway. stories.title: North Wales Police warn of rise in AI-powered scam messages targeting public
stories.summary: North Wales Police are warning residents to be on their guard after an increase in highly convincing phishing scams across the region. Criminals are using artificial intelligence to create realistic-looking messages that appear to come from trusted organisations including banks, HMRC, the NHS and delivery companies. stories.title: Senedd Members grill First Minister on health service in Wales
stories.summary: Senedd Members pressed the First Minister over the state of the health service in Wales, as the Plaid Cymru leader faced his inaugural First Minister’s Questions. Rhun ap Iorwerth faced his colleagues in the Siambr on Tuesday (2 June) to be questioned on the work achieved so far by the first-ever Plaid Cymru Welsh Government.
